explication: Trino is a distributed SQL analytics engine, with the CLI and client libraries providing user-facing access and connectors exposing external data systems. The main workflow is submitting SQL, managing and scheduling a query, then executing distributed work and returning results. The excerpts directly show query management, scheduler responsibilities, session state, and pipeline statistics; the README documents CLI-to-server use and plugin-based connector configuration. Several central stages, including parsing, planning, and result transport, are represented at their enclosing source directories because their implementation files were not sampled.
